name: Kenneth Newcombe

summary.text: Kenneth Newcombe is the founder and former chief executive of carbon-credit project developer C-Quest Capital. On October 2, 2024 the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York announced wire fraud, commodities fraud and securities fraud charges against him, alleging a multi-year scheme to inflate emissions reductions from cookstove projects; the CFTC filed a parallel civil complaint. He stepped down as CEO in February 2024. A spokesman denied the allegations.

facts.claim: Newcombe was charged by the Southern District of New York with wire fraud, commodities fraud and securities fraud; co-defendant Tridip Goswami was charged with wire and commodities fraud.
facts.quote: Newcombe faces wire fraud, commodities fraud, and securities fraud counts, and Goswami faces wire and commodities fraud counts.

facts.claim: The CFTC filed a civil complaint alleging that from at least 2019 to about December 2023 Newcombe engaged in a fraudulent scheme involving false and misleading reports to at least one carbon-credit registry and third-party reviewers.
facts.quote: from at least 2019 to at least in or about Dec. 2023, he engaged in a fraudulent scheme involving false and misleading reports to at least one carbon credit registry and third-party reviewers

facts.claim: Prosecutors alleged Newcombe falsified emissions-reduction data to obtain millions of carbon credits and more than $100 million in investment, and covered up lower-than-expected reductions to drive project growth.
facts.quote: Prosecutors claim he covered up lower-than-expected emissions reductions to drive aggressive project growth.
